title: Preparing for Farmers Insurance Open!
description:
For decades, the world’s best golfers have tested their skills at Torrey Pines Golf Course. 

Starting tomorrow, Jan. 29 - Feb. 1, the Farmers Insurance Open is back, and the City Golf Division is dialing in the course to precision PGA TOUR standards.

Catch your local municipal course on TV this weekend, or stop by and visit the pro shop. See you at Torrey! 

#PGA #SeeYouAtTorrey #golf
